endpoints.name: CreateIndent
endpoints.business_purpose: Create direct dispatch indent with products, auto-approve, auto-dispatch, update stock.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates indent, auto-approves by branch and credit, marks dispatched, updates product stock for each line item.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Dealer exists. Products exist with valid grade/thickness/size. Branch exists for dealer area.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. Dealer valid. Product details valid. Quantity/Weight > 0.
business_logic.side_effects: Inventory stock updated. Indent marked dispatched. Multiple DB writes.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Quantity and Weight must be greater than zero for all indent details.
Invalid product details for product: {detail.ProductName}, Grade: {detail.Grade}, Thickness: {detail.Thickness}, Size: {detail.Size}
No branch found for the selected area.

idempotency.notes: Stock updates non-idempotent. Multiple calls decrement stock multiple times.

endpoints.short_description: Create direct dispatch indent with products, auto-approve, auto-dispatch, update stock.
endpoints.detailed_description: Create direct dispatch indent with products, auto-approve, auto-dispatch, update stock. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IIndent.GetDealerById, IIndent.GetFactoryByIdAsync. Persists changes to: IndentHeader: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid dealer ID [when dealer == null]; Quantity and Weight must be greater than zero for all indent details. [when detail.Quantity <= 0 || detail.Weight <= 0]; Invalid product details for product: {detail.ProductName}, Grade: {detail.Grade}, Thickness: {detail.Thickness}, Size: {detail.Size} [when product == null]; No branch found for the selected area. [when branch == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes indent record. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Indent ID > 0. Indent must exist.
business_logic.state_changes: IndentHeader: UPDATE; soft delete (is_deleted flag); AuditLog: INSERT
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

endpoints.short_description: Delete (soft delete) direct dispatch indent record.
endpoints.detailed_description: Delete (soft delete) direct dispatch indent record. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFactoryDirectDispatch.GetFactoryDirectDispatchById, ICommon.ToJsonString, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: IndentHeader: UPDATE, soft delete (is_deleted flag), AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when current_user == null]
